testCase.name: XML Layout Inflation
testCase.description: Runtime inflation error due to unknown attribute

error.message: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView

expectedFix.explanation: Remove invalid attribute or use android:textStyle="bold"

agent_response.error: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView
agent_response.rootCause: The TextView class does not have an appropriate constructor signature for XML layout inflation. It should use @JvmOverloads with specific parameters to support (Context, AttributeSet?) when compiling against a JAR file.
fixGuidelines: 1. Replace the current constructor of TextView with one that uses @JvmOverloads and includes Context or (Context, AttributeSet?) as parameters. Ensure the constructor is compatible with the version specified in the JAR file.
2. In the project's pom.xml, specify the exact version number for the JAR containing the compiled class files to ensure proper compatibility during inflation.
3. Provide a clear before-and-after code example showing the modification of the TextView class constructor and any necessary imports or annotations added.
4. Verify the fix by running the application with the correct command line arguments that include the appropriate version information for the JAR file.
